title: HMMT November Guts Round — six-person proxy

applicability.notes: The benchmark row must carry season=nov; this resolves the six-versus-eight roster failure in the current flat card.

required_roles.title: captain and batch submitter
duties: Prioritize the current batch and authorize the shared answer submission.

required_roles.title: independent verifier
duties: Check proposed answers independently before the batch is submitted.

required_roles.title: answer-sheet scribe
duties: Maintain the numbered answer sheet and record unresolved items.

fill_role.title: problem solver
duties: Solve assigned problems and communicate concise derivations for verification.

turn_budget.derivation: Six agents receive a bounded coordination budget; this is not an official clock equivalent.

state_requirements.description: Problems arrive in sequential batches and later batches remain hidden until the current batch is committed.
A submitted batch cannot be revised.

constraints.statement: The November Guts roster used by these benchmark rows has six active teammates.
Work only on the released batch and commit the shared answers before receiving the next batch.
The runner uses turns as a safety budget instead of reproducing the official wall clock.

collaboration.notes: Required roles remain stable, while solver assignments may change by batch.

submission.adaptation: The physical batch sheet is serialized as text.

evaluation.notes: Use official multipart answers; score batch protocol compliance separately.

waivers.official_rule: The official contest is played by human students.
waivers.benchmark_treatment: LLM agents simulate the student team.

sources.title: HMMT tournament testing information
sources.locator: Guts round format and tournament instructions

provenance.notes: The six-person November roster is explicit in this ruleset instead of being forced through an eight-role template.
